claims.text: In this single stop tour, you will experience the maritime charm and culinary excellence of a renowned seafood restaurant nestled in the North End Waterfront since 1984.
The Boston Sail Loft weaves New England's seafood traditions with family-owned resilience, offering a culinary experience rooted in personal storytelling.
Founded in 1984 on Atlantic Avenue near Long Wharf, this spot serves as a go-to destination for classic New England seafood delights, accompanied by breathtaking views of the Boston Harbor.
Since its establishment in 1984, the Boston Sail Loft has become a cherished fixture in the North End Waterfront, offering an inviting slice of classic New England seafood.
The chowder's acclaim extended far beyond Boston, sweeping regional awards and even making appearances on national morning shows.
Meals are priced at $30 and under, offering an accessible delight for anyone craving the taste of the sea.
The venue operates from 11:30 am to 2:00 am on Mondays and Tuesdays, ideal for a midday meal or a late-night bite.
Stepping inside the Sail Loft, you can savor the legendary clam chowder, a dish that has consistently drawn locals and visitors back.
The flavors of the ocean blend with the rich history of Boston's waterfront, creating a timeless and unforgettable dining experience.
